e.z: 他們認為他的行為不正常。

e.e: The ship was blown off course by abnormal weather conditions.
e.z: 船隻因異常天氣狀況而偏離航線。

e.e: This tax should be abolished.
e.z: 這項稅收應該被廢除。

d.m: 在船上；在火车上；在飞机上

e.e: He was already aboard the plane.
e.z: 他已經在飛機上了。

e.e: The plane crashed, killing all 157 passengers aboard.
e.z: 飛機墜毀，機上157名乘客全部罹難。

e.e: And it is only the white locals who profit from the tourist industry by peddling Aboriginal cultural artifacts such as didgeridoos and boomerangs.
e.z: 白当地居民从土著的文化产物的旅游工业来获取利益，比如迪吉里杜管和回飞棒。

e.e: He is an artist with an abiding concern for humanity.
e.z: 他是一位對人類懷有持久關懷的藝術家。

e.e: The virus can cause pregnant animals to abort.
e.z: 這種病毒可能導致懷孕的動物流產。

e.e: If the wrong password is given the program aborts.
e.z: 如果輸入錯誤的密碼，程式會中止。

e.e: We had no option but to abort the mission.
e.z: 我們別無選擇，只能中止任務。

e.e: The plan was aborted at the last minute.
e.z: 這個計劃在最後一刻被取消了。

e.e: Stories about his travels abound.
e.z: 關於他旅行的故事比比皆是。

e.e: Welcome to my humble abode.
e.z: 欢迎光临寒舍。

e.e: They established their permanent abode here.
e.z: 他们在此建立了永久居所。

e.e: The suspect is a person of no fixed abode.
e.z: 嫌疑犯是个居无定所的人。

d.m: 能够的；有能力的；能干的

e.e: You must be able to speak French for this job.
e.z: 做這份工作你必須會說法語。

e.e: I didn't feel able to disagree with him.
e.z: 我覺得無法反駁他。

e.e: These families are less able to afford a balanced, healthy diet.
e.z: 這些家庭較難負擔均衡健康的飲食。

e.e: She's the ablest student in the class.
e.z: 她是班上最有能力的學生。

e.e: A gentle form of exercise will increase your ability to relax.
e.z: 溫和的運動形式能增強你放鬆的能力。

e.e: A woman of her ability will easily find a job.
e.z: 像她這樣有能力的女性很容易找到工作。

e.e: It's important to discover the natural abilities of each child.
e.z: 發現每個孩子的天賦能力很重要。

col.phrase: to the best of one's ability

e.e: At that instant, a coin slipped out of the aborigine’s hand.
e.z: 正在此时，一枚硬币从土著人的手中滑落。

e.e: I understood about the Australian aboriginal culture by an aborigine explained.
e.z: 因现场有位原住民解说使我得以了解澳洲原住民的文化。

e.e: He suffered cuts and abrasions to the face.
e.z: 他臉部有割傷和擦傷。

e.e: Diamonds have extreme resistance to abrasion.
e.z: 鑽石對磨損有極高的抵抗力。

e.e: Both pro-choice and anti-abortion groups want to ensure their voices are heard.
e.z: 支持選擇權和反墮胎的團體都希望確保他們的聲音被聽見。

e.e: Some medical staff wanted the right to refuse to perform abortions.
e.z: 一些醫護人員希望有權拒絕執行墮胎手術。

e.e: It is almost impossible to keep abreast of all the latest developments in computing.
e.z: 要跟上電腦領域所有最新發展幾乎是不可能的。

e.e: I like to keep abreast of current affairs.
e.z: 我喜歡隨時了解時事。

e.e: It’s important to keep abreast with the latest legislation.
e.z: 跟上最新的法規很重要。

e.e: The interview ended abruptly.
e.z: 訪談突然結束了。

e.e: We did not receive any news during his long absence.
e.z: 在他長期缺席期間，我們沒有收到任何消息。

e.e: I was surprised by the absence of any women on the board of directors.
e.z: 我對董事會中沒有任何女性感到驚訝。

e.e: The case was dismissed in the absence of any definite proof.
e.z: 在缺乏明確證據的情況下，此案被駁回。

e.e: The meeting went well but Nigel was conspicuous by his absence.
e.z: 會議進行得很順利，但奈傑爾的缺席格外引人注目。

col.zh: 在缺乏…的情况下；当…不在时

e.e: The water came above our knees.
e.z: 水淹到了我們的膝蓋以上。

e.e: We were flying above the clouds.
e.z: 我們在雲層上方飛行。

e.e: A captain in the navy ranks above a captain in the army.
e.z: 海軍上校的軍階高於陸軍上尉。

e.e: They finished the year six places above their local rivals.
e.z: 他們在年底排名比當地競爭對手高出六個名次。

e.e: Temperatures have been above average.
e.z: 氣溫一直高於平均水準。

e.e: I'm very absent-minded and often forget to take my keys with me.
e.z: 我非常健忘，經常忘記帶鑰匙。

e.e: She's nothing like the popular stereotype of the absent-minded professor.
e.z: 她一點也不像一般刻板印象中那種心不在焉的教授。

e.e: The absentee cooked up some excuse about being ill.
e.z: 那位缺席者编造了一个有病的借口。

e.e: The absentee is a person who is absent from work.
e.z: 旷工者就是上班不到的人。

d.m: 完全地；绝对地；[语]独立地
（表示赞同）完全正确，一点没错

e.e: The place was absolutely packed.
e.z: 那個地方擠得不得了。

e.e: It was absolutely pouring with rain.
e.z: 當時雨下得非常大。

e.e: There's absolutely nothing more the doctors can do.
e.z: 醫生們真的無能為力了。

e.e: White-collar crime increased both absolutely and in comparison with other categories.
e.z: 白領犯罪無論在絕對數字上還是與其他類別相比，都有所增加。

e.e: She was absent from work for two weeks.
e.z: 她兩個星期沒來上班。

e.e: Local people were conspicuously absent from the meeting.
e.z: 當地人明顯缺席了那次會議。

e.e: Love was totally absent from his childhood.
e.z: 他的童年完全缺乏愛。

e.e: She now played with a passion that had been strangely absent from her previous performance.
e.z: 她這次演奏充滿熱情，而這種熱情在她之前的表演中奇怪地缺席了。

d.m: 在国外；海外(一般作表语)

e.e: She worked abroad for a year.
e.z: 她在國外工作了一年。

e.e: For a holiday abroad you need a valid passport.
e.z: 出國度假需要有效的護照。

e.e: There was news abroad that a change was coming.
e.z: 有傳聞說即將發生變革。

d.m: 抽象的；理论的；抽象派的

e.e: The research shows that pre-school children are capable of thinking in abstract terms.
e.z: 研究顯示，學齡前兒童有能力進行抽象思考。

e.e: We may talk of beautiful things but beauty itself is abstract.
e.z: 我們可以談論美麗的事物，但美本身是抽象的。

e.e: The court absolved him of all responsibility for the accident.
e.z: 法院免除了他對事故的所有責任。

e.e: I absolve you from all your sins.
e.z: 我赦免你所有的罪。

d.m: 吸收；吸引 ... 的注意；吞并

e.e: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air.
e.z: 植物從空氣中吸收二氧化碳。

e.e: Let the rice cook until it has absorbed all the water.
e.z: 讓米飯煮到吸收所有水分。

e.e: The cream is easily absorbed into the skin.
e.z: 這種乳霜很容易被皮膚吸收。

e.e: Black walls absorb a lot of heat during the day.
e.z: 黑色牆壁在白天吸收大量熱量。

e.e: This tennis racket absorbs shock on impact.
e.z: 這個網球拍在撞擊時能吸收震動。

e.e: I've joined a class for absolute beginners.
e.z: 我參加了一個專為初學者開設的班級。

e.e: Around them the darkness was absolute, the silence oppressive.
e.z: 他們周圍一片漆黑，寂靜得令人壓抑。

e.e: They're talking absolute nonsense.
e.z: 他們說的完全是胡說八道。

e.e: He must earn an absolute fortune.
e.z: 他一定賺了一大筆錢。

e.e: He taught us that the laws of physics were absolute.
e.z: 他教導我們物理定律是絕對的。

e.e: The accident brought his career to an abrupt end.
e.z: 那場事故讓他的職業生涯戛然而止。

e.e: He indicated Isabel with an abrupt movement of his head.
e.z: 他突然動了一下頭，指向伊莎貝爾。

e.e: She was very abrupt with me in our meeting.
e.z: 她在我們會議上對我態度非常生硬。

e.e: Ten people voted in favour, five against and two abstained.
e.z: 十人投票贊成，五人反對，兩人棄權。

e.e: The workers who abstained from work yesterday have been suspended.
e.z: 昨天曠工的工人已被停職。

e.e: There's something strange about him.
e.z: 他這個人有點奇怪。

e.e: There's something about this business that is not quite right.
e.z: 這件事有些不對勁。

e.e: There's nothing you can do about it now.
e.z: 你現在對此無能為力。

e.e: Everywhere people were going about their daily business.
e.z: 到處都是人們在忙著自己的日常事務。

e.e: We wandered about the town for an hour or so.
e.z: 我們在鎮上逛了大約一個小時。

e.e: Philosophical semantics is too abstruse to understand.
e.z: 哲学语义学深奥难懂。

e.e: Einstein's theory of relativity is very abstruse.
e.z: 爱因斯坦的相对论非常难懂。

d.m: 荒唐的；可笑的；不合理的

e.e: That uniform makes the guards look absurd.
e.z: 那套制服讓警衛看起來很可笑。

e.e: Of course it's not true, what an absurd idea.
e.z: 當然不是真的，真是個荒謬的想法。

e.e: He has a good sense of the absurd.
e.z: 他對荒謬的事物有很好的領悟力。

e.e: He became abusive when he was drunk.
e.z: 他喝醉時會口出惡言。

e.e: She was fined for making abusive comments to the referee.
e.z: 她因對裁判出言不遜而被罰款。

e.e: The legal system is open to abuse.
e.z: 這個法律體系容易被濫用。

e.e: What she did was an abuse of her position as manager.
e.z: 她的所作所為是濫用經理職權。

e.e: They suffered years of physical abuse.
e.z: 他們遭受了多年的身體虐待。

e.e: The man burst into a torrent of foul-mouthed racist abuse.
e.z: 那個人突然爆出一連串骯髒的種族歧視辱罵。

e.e: The brochure promised beautiful walks with an abundance of wildlife.
e.z: 宣傳冊上承諾有美麗的步道和豐富的野生動物。

e.e: The country has an abundance of natural resources.
e.z: 這個國家擁有豐富的自然資源。

e.e: We were amazed by the sheer abundance of food.
e.z: 食物數量之多讓我們驚訝不已。

e.e: Fruit and vegetables grew in abundance on the island.
e.z: 島上盛產水果和蔬菜。

e.e: Exotic plants grew there in great abundance.
e.z: 那裡生長著極其豐富的異國植物。

d.m: 大学教师，大学生；学者，学究

e.e: The university is renowned throughout the world for its academic excellence.
e.z: 這所大學以其卓越的學術成就聞名於世。

e.e: She wasn't very academic and hated school.
e.z: 她不太擅長學術，討厭上學。

e.e: The whole thing's academic now—we can't win anyway.
e.z: 現在整件事都無關緊要了——反正我們贏不了。

e.e: Most of his questions were of an academic nature.
e.z: 他的問題大多屬於學術性質。

e.e: Inflation continues to accelerate.
e.z: 通貨膨脹持續加速。

e.e: Exposure to the sun can accelerate the ageing process.
e.z: 暴露在陽光下會加速老化過程。

e.e: The runners accelerated smoothly around the bend.
e.z: 跑者們平穩地在彎道加速。

e.e: The car accelerated to overtake me.
e.z: 那輛車加速超過了我。

e.e: The car purred into life and accelerated away.
e.z: 汽車輕柔地發動起來，然後加速駛離。

e.e: This model has the best acceleration of any available sports car.
e.z: 這款車型在任何現有跑車中擁有最佳的加速性能。

d.m: 抽象；抽象概念；心不在焉

e.e: Ideological abstractions are never going to attract many voters.
e.z: 意識形態的抽象概念永遠不會吸引很多選民。

e.e: The increasing abstraction of modern art has tended to make it increasingly difficult to interpret.
e.z: 現代藝術日益抽象化，往往使其越來越難以解讀。

e.e: The idea of ‘the nation’ can be seen as an abstraction.
e.z: 「國家」這個概念可以被視為一種抽象。

e.e: She was gazing in abstraction at the far corner of the room.
e.z: 她出神地凝視著房間的遠角。

e.e: He asked me to marry him and I accepted.
e.z: 他向我求婚，我答應了。

e.e: Please accept our sincere apologies.
e.z: 請接受我們誠摯的歉意。

e.e: She's decided not to accept the job.
e.z: 她決定不接受這份工作。

e.e: Please accept this small token of my appreciation.
e.z: 請收下這份小禮物，聊表謝意。

e.e: He is charged with accepting bribes from a firm of suppliers.
e.z: 他被指控收受一家供應商公司的賄賂。

d.m: 合意的；受欢迎的；可接受的

e.e: For this course a pass in English at grade B is acceptable.
e.z: 這門課程要求英文成績達到B級才算合格。

e.e: Air pollution in the city had reached four times the acceptable levels.
e.z: 這座城市的空氣污染已達到可接受水準的四倍。

e.e: The food was acceptable, but no more.
e.z: 食物還可以，但也就那樣。

e.e: Inspectors found that teaching standards were acceptable, but could be improved.
e.z: 督學發現教學水準可以接受，但還有改進空間。

e.e: Please confirm your acceptance of this offer in writing.
e.z: 請以書面方式確認您接受此報價。

e.e: Invitations have been sent out and 80 acceptances have already been received.
e.z: 邀請函已寄出，目前已收到八十份接受回覆。

e.e: So far we have had one refusal and three acceptances.
e.z: 到目前為止，我們收到一份拒絕和三份接受。

e.e: Your acceptance into the insurance plan is guaranteed.
e.z: 您加入此保險計劃的資格已獲得保證。

e.e: Social acceptance is important for most young people.
e.z: 對大多數年輕人來說，社會認同很重要。

e.e: She trained at the Royal Academy of Music.
e.z: 她曾在皇家音樂學院受訓。

e.e: Her short hair accentuated her huge eyes.
e.z: 她的短髮凸顯了她的大眼睛。

e.e: The fundamental patterns of inequality have remained and have been accentuated by the war.
e.z: 不平等的基本模式依然存在，並因戰爭而更加惡化。

e.e: When talks did occur, they tended to accentuate differences between the two groups.
e.z: 當會談確實發生時，往往會凸顯兩個群體之間的差異。

e.e: She made her wishes abundantly clear.
e.z: 她非常清楚地表達了她的意願。

e.e: Calcium is found most abundantly in milk.
e.z: 鈣質在牛奶中含量最為豐富。

syn.m: 充足, 大量, 丰富, ...

d.m: 公认的；录取的；可接受的

e.e: There is no universally accepted definition of basic needs.
e.z: 對於基本需求，並沒有一個普遍接受的定義。

e.e: Everything about the child’s adoption was against accepted practice.
e.z: 這個孩子被領養的一切過程都違反了公認的做法。

e.e: He was killed in an accident.
e.z: 他在一場意外中喪生。

e.e: One in seven accidents is caused by sleepy drivers.
e.z: 每七起事故中，就有一起因駕駛疲勞所致。

e.e: The accident happened at 3 p.m.
e.z: 事故發生在下午三點。

e.e: Every year in the United Kingdom more than 4 000 people die in accidents in the home.
e.z: 在英國，每年有超過四千人死於居家意外。

e.e: Their early arrival was just an accident.
e.z: 他們提早到達純屬偶然。

e.e: She spoke English with an accent.
e.z: 她說英語帶有口音。

e.e: The Americans had learned Korean and spoke with a good accent.
e.z: 這些美國人學過韓語，而且口音說得很好。

e.e: In ‘today’ the accent is on the second syllable.
e.z: 在「today」這個字中，重音在第二個音節。

e.e: Canapé has an accent on the ‘e’.
e.z: 「Canapé」這個字的「e」上面有一個重音符號。

d.m: 意外的； 偶然的； 附属的
偶然； 不重要的东西； <音>变调的临时符号

e.e: I didn't think our meeting was accidental—he must have known I would be there.
e.z: 我認為我們的相遇並非偶然——他一定知道我會在那裡。

d.m: 表扬；嘉奖；武士爵位的授与

e.e: Four restaurants have been awarded the highest accolade of a three-star rating.
e.z: 有四家餐廳獲得了三星評級的最高榮譽。

e.e: He was finally awarded the ultimate accolade —British Hairdresser of the Year—five years later.
e.z: 五年後，他終於獲得了終極榮譽——英國年度最佳髮型設計師。

e.e: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
e.z: 這間飯店最多可容納五百位客人。

e.e: The aircraft is capable of accommodating 28 passengers.
e.z: 這架飛機可容納二十八名乘客。

e.e: The garage can accommodate three cars.
e.z: 這個車庫可以停放三輛車。

e.e: The old town hall now accommodates a Folk Museum.
e.z: 舊市政廳現在設有一座民俗博物館。

e.e: Our proposal tries to accommodate the special needs of minority groups.
e.z: 我們的提案試圖照顧少數群體的特殊需求。

e.e: The work was acclaimed as a masterpiece.
e.z: 這部作品被譽為傑作。

e.e: This book has been widely acclaimed as a modern classic.
e.z: 這本書被廣泛譽為現代經典之作。

e.e: David was gentle, generous and accommodating.
e.z: 大衛溫柔、慷慨且樂於助人。

e.e: They are very accommodating to overseas visitors.
e.z: 他們對海外遊客非常體貼。

e.e: They are very accommodating to people with special needs.
e.z: 他們對有特殊需求的人非常包容。

d.m: 动词acclaim的过去式、过去分词
可得到的；易接近的；可进入的

e.e: The remote desert area is accessible only by helicopter.
e.z: 這個偏遠的沙漠地區只能搭乘直升機到達。

e.e: These documents are not accessible to the public.
e.z: 這些文件不對公眾開放。

e.e: The beach should be accessible to everyone.
e.z: 這個海灘應該讓每個人都能方便到達。

e.e: Her poetry is always very accessible.
e.z: 她的詩歌總是很容易理解。

e.e: Hotel accommodation is included in the price of your holiday.
e.z: 飯店住宿已包含在您的假期費用中。

e.e: First-class accommodation is available on all flights.
e.z: 所有航班均提供頭等艙座位。

e.e: It can be difficult to find suitable accommodation for those in need.
e.z: 為有需要的人找到合適的住所可能很困難。

e.e: The building plans include much needed new office accommodation.
e.z: 這項建築計劃包含了急需的新辦公空間。

e.e: More and more travelers are looking for bed and breakfast accommodations in private homes.
e.z: 越來越多的旅客在尋找私人住宅提供的民宿住宿。

col.zh: 为…提供住宿；为…做出调整

e.e: The first part of the plan has been safely accomplished.
e.z: 該計劃的第一部分已順利完成。

e.z: 這些農民大規模種植農作物。

e.e: He suffered a massive heart attack.
e.z: 他遭受了嚴重的心臟病發作。

e.e: They have a massive great house.
e.z: 他們有一棟非常大的房子。

e.e: He was a working mason at Westminster Abbey in the sixteenth century.
e.z: 他在十六世紀是西敏寺的一名石匠。

e.e: They are playing an important match against Liverpool on Saturday.
e.z: 他們星期六要與利物浦進行一場重要的比賽。

e.e: I'll probably watch the match on TV.
e.z: 我可能會在電視上看那場比賽。

e.e: Dublin took on Toulouse in their opening match of the European Cup.
e.z: 都柏林在歐洲盃的首場比賽中對陣圖盧茲。

e.e: I was no match for him at tennis.
e.z: 打網球我根本不是他的對手。

e.e: We should be a match for most teams.
e.z: 我們應該能與大多數球隊匹敵。

e.e: Every item we sell is made out of recycled material.
e.z: 我們銷售的每件商品都是用回收材料製成的。

e.e: All the furniture is crafted from natural materials.
e.z: 所有家具都是用天然材料手工製作的。

e.e: Bacteria help break down dead plant material such as fallen leaves.
e.z: 細菌有助於分解枯葉等植物材料。

e.e: We have 98% of the same genetic material as chimpanzees.
e.z: 我們與黑猩猩有98%相同的遺傳物質。

e.e: They publish a range of educational materials.
e.z: 他們出版一系列教育教材。

d.m: 使 ... 配对；使 ... 一致

e.e: They've been best mates since school.
e.z: 他們從學生時代起就是最好的朋友。

e.e: Sorry mate, you'll have to wait.
e.z: 抱歉，老兄，你得等一下。

e.e: A male bird sings to attract a mate.
e.z: 雄鳥唱歌來吸引伴侶。

e.e: Many matchmaking sites compile lists of potential mates using basic information.
e.z: 許多婚戀網站利用基本資訊列出潛在伴侶名單。

e.e: The promotion he had been promised failed to materialize.
e.z: 他承諾的晉升未能實現。

e.e: A tall figure suddenly materialized at her side.
e.z: 一個高大的身影突然出現在她身邊。

e.e: Do the math before you take on more debt.
e.z: 在承擔更多債務之前，先算清楚帳。

d.m: 唯物主义；唯物论；实利主义

e.e: Both of them believed in Marxism and materialism.
e.z: 两人都信仰马克思主义和唯物主义。

e.e: Crass materialism causes people to forget spiritual values.
e.z: 极端唯物主义使人忘掉精神价值。

e.e: Metaphysics goes against materialism.
e.z: 玄学和唯物论是相违背的。

e.e: He worked out the very difficult mathematics in great detail.
e.z: 他非常詳細地解出了那道極難的數學題。

e.e: Her proof is a remarkable piece of mathematics.
e.z: 她的證明是一項卓越的數學成果。

e.e: The mathematics of baseball is/are very interesting.
e.z: 棒球的數學原理非常有趣。

d.m: 数学的；精确的；可能性极小的

e.e: He's deeply engrossed in mathematical research.
e.z: 他醉心于数学的研究。

e.e: It is important not to be overawed by the mathematical jargon.
e.z: 要紧的是不要被数学的术语所吓倒。

e.e: Both rely on mathematical calculations to determine the location from which a positron or photon was emitted.
e.z: 这两种成像方法均依靠精确的计算来决定正电子或光于发射的位置。

d.m: 成熟的；(保单）到期的；考虑周到的

e.e: Jane is very mature for her age.
e.z: 珍妮以她的年齡來說非常成熟。

e.e: She tries to look mature and sophisticated.
e.z: 她試圖讓自己看起來成熟又世故。

e.e: There's something the matter with my eyes.
e.z: 我的眼睛有問題。

e.e: What on earth was the matter with her, she wondered. She’d come here to enjoy herself and here she was, stuck on her own in the hotel.
e.z: 她心想，她到底怎麼了？她本來是來這裡享受的，結果卻獨自困在飯店裡。

e.e: They had important matters to discuss.
e.z: 他們有重要的事情要討論。

e.e: She may need your help with some business matters.
e.z: 她可能在一些商業事務上需要你的幫助。

e.e: They've agreed in theory, but now we need to discuss practical matters.
e.z: 他們在理論上已經同意了，但現在我們需要討論實際問題。

d.m: 铺席子的；缠结的；遍地丛生的

e.e: Her hair was matted and tangled.
e.z: 她的頭髮糾結成一團。

e.e: The dog’s coat easily becomes matted.
e.z: 這隻狗的毛很容易打結。

d.m: 编织；集结；铺席于 ... 上

e.e: Wipe your feet on the mat before you come in, please.
e.z: 請進門前先在墊子上擦擦腳。

e.e: The man unrolled his prayer mat.
e.z: 那名男子展開了祈禱墊。

e.e: She was mauled by guards at the border.
e.z: 她在邊境被警衛粗暴攻擊。

e.e: Prints are available on matt or glossy paper.
e.z: 照片可選用霧面或光面相紙沖印。

e.e: I will build the most beautiful mausoleum for you.
e.z: 我会为你建造一座最美丽的陵墓。

e.e: Cleopatra was imprisoned inside her mausoleum on the day of her death.
e.z: 克利奥帕特拉在她临终前的最后一天是被监禁在她自己的陵墓里。

d.m: 未打烙印的小牛；持不同意见者

e.e: Politically, she's a bit of a maverick.
e.z: 在政治方面，她有点自行其是。

e.e: The Republican maverick was disliked and distrusted by too many in the party.
e.z: 而在共和党内部，有太多人对这位特立独行者抱以嫌恶和不信任的态度。

e.e: Robby was a maverick vice cop, never doing things in legal way.
e.z: 华比是个特立独行的黑警察，从不以正当手段行事。

d.m: 最大量；最大限度；最高点

e.e: The table has a length of four feet maximum.
e.z: 這張桌子最長四英尺。

e.e: We can sleep on a mattress on the floor.
e.z: 我們可以睡在地板上的床墊上。

e.e: This was a maxim well understood by Turloch.
e.z: 这是特洛克心领神会的格言。

e.e: This maxim has been done to death.
e.z: 这个格言重复得太多了，简直令人发腻。

e.e: Please lay the maxim to your heart.
e.z: 请把此格箴言记在心里。

d.m: 可以，能够；可能，也许；祝，愿

e.e: There is a range of programs on the market which may be described as design aids.
e.z: 市面上有許多可稱為設計輔助工具的程式。

e.e: They may be well-meaning, but they are wrong.
e.z: 他們或許出於好意，但他們錯了。

e.e: You look lovely, if I may say so.
e.z: 恕我直言，你看起來很可愛。

e.e: There is a need for more resources so that all children may have a decent education.
e.z: 需要更多資源，這樣所有孩子才能接受良好的教育。

e.e: I know that he has tried hard; be that as it may, his work is just not good enough.
e.z: 我知道他已經很努力了；儘管如此，他的工作表現還是不夠好。

e.e: It's mathematically impossible.
e.z: 這在數學上是不可能的。

e.e: It was medieval European monks who introduced scientific brewing techniques in an effort to produce a nutritious beverage to supplement their meager diets.
e.z: 正是中世纪欧洲的僧侣们引进科学的啤酒酿造技术，制造有营养的饮料，从而补充了他们贫乏的饮食。

e.e: Mayonnaise is made from egg yolks and oil.
e.z: 蛋黄酱是用蛋黄和油制成的。

e.e: My dad was a truck driver and my mom was working in a mayonnaise factory when they met.
e.z: 我爸妈相识的时候，我爸还是个卡车司机，而我妈在蛋黄酱工厂上班。

d.m: 使增加至最大限度；充分利用

e.e: Maximize the window to full screen.
e.z: 將視窗最大化至全螢幕。

e.e: The purpose of the restructuring is to maximize opportunities in the global market.
e.z: 重組的目的是為了在全球市場中最大化機會。

e.e: He has maturity beyond his years.
e.z: 他擁有超越年齡的成熟。

e.e: Her poems show great maturity.
e.z: 她的詩展現出極高的成熟度。

e.e: She has shown great maturity in her behaviour this term.
e.z: 她這學期的行為表現出很大的成熟。

e.e: The insects lay eggs when they approach maturity.
e.z: 昆蟲在接近成熟時產卵。

e.e: These latest paintings show how the artist has really grown in maturity.
e.z: 這些最新的畫作顯示這位藝術家真正在成熟度上有所成長。

e.e: The mayor made a speech at the opening.
e.z: 市长在开幕式上发表了演说。

e.e: The mayor is determined to clean up the city.
e.z: 市长决心清除市内的不良现象。

e.e: He is the deputy mayor of the city.
e.z: 他是本市的副市长。

e.e: Try not to eat between meals.
e.z: 盡量不要在兩餐之間吃東西。

e.e: Lunch is his main meal of the day.
e.z: 午餐是他一天中的主餐。

e.e: They are learning to cook simple, healthy meals.
e.z: 他們正在學習烹飪簡單健康的餐點。

e.e: He looks as though he hasn't had a square meal for weeks.
e.z: 他看起來好像好幾週沒吃過一頓像樣的飯了。

d.m: 缓慢而弯曲地流动；漫步；闲聊
河流的曲折；漫步；迂回曲折的进程

e.e: The stream meanders slowly down to the sea.
e.z: 這條溪流蜿蜒緩慢地流向大海。

e.e: The road meanders along the valley floor.
e.z: 這條路沿著谷底蜿蜒而行。

e.e: They meandered around the old town admiring the architecture.
e.z: 他們在老城區四處漫步，欣賞建築。

e.e: Traditional hay meadows are important wildlife areas.
e.z: 傳統乾草草地是重要的野生動物區域。

e.e: Water meadows were constructed along the river valleys.
e.z: 沿著河谷建造了水草地。

d.m: 意思是，意味（动词mean的第三人称单数）

e.e: Interest rates are used as a means of controlling borrowing.
e.z: 利率被用作控制借貸的手段。

e.e: They are using peaceful means to achieve their aims.
e.z: 他們使用和平手段來達成目標。

e.e: Music is the best means we have to reach a wide audience.
e.z: 音樂是我們接觸廣大觀眾的最佳方式。

e.e: Equality is an end in itself, not just a means to a goal.
e.z: 平等本身就是目的，而不只是達成目標的手段。

e.e: This weed can be controlled by various means.
e.z: 這種雜草可以透過多種方式控制。

e.e: Words often have several meanings.
e.z: 詞語通常有多種含義。

e.e: I am using the word with its original meaning.
e.z: 我使用這個詞時用的是它的原始意義。

e.e: It is important to make your meaning clear.
e.z: 清楚表達你的意思很重要。

e.e: What's the meaning of this? I explicitly told you not to leave the room.
e.z: 這是什麼意思？我明明告訴過你不要離開房間。

e.e: With Anna he learned the meaning of love.
e.z: 和安娜在一起，他學會了愛的意義。

d.m: 无意义的；不重要的；晦涩的

e.e: We fill up our lives with meaningless tasks.
e.z: 我們用無意義的任務填滿生活。

e.e: Fines are meaningless to a huge company like that.
e.z: 罰款對那樣的大公司來說毫無意義。

e.e: To me that painting is completely meaningless.
e.z: 對我來說，那幅畫完全沒有意義。

e.e: She threw a meaningful look at him.
e.z: 她向他投去意味深长的目光。

e.e: There are many meaningful long scenes in this director's films.
e.z: 这位导演的影片中有很多意味深长的长镜头。

e.e: A poet can convert ordinary words into a meaningful and effective piece of writing.
e.z: 诗人能够把普通的词汇化为意味深长而又动人的诗篇。

syn.m: 引起回忆或唤起感情的...

e.e: Maybe he'll come, maybe he won't.
e.z: 他也許會來，也許不會。

e.e: Is she right? Maybe, maybe not.
e.z: 她是對的嗎？也許是，也許不是。

e.e: Maybe it will do me some good to go for a run.
e.z: 去跑步也許對我有好處。

e.e: It will cost two, maybe three hundred pounds.
e.z: 這會花費兩百，也許三百英鎊。

e.e: We go there maybe once or twice a month.
e.z: 我們大概一個月去那裡一兩次。

e.e: Mr Ma is on trial for allegedly embezzling a mayoral special allowance and has vowed to remain in the race even if found guilty.
e.z: 马英九涉嫌挪用市长的特别津贴费而且已经确认即使被判有罪也将竞选。

e.e: The word ‘Kuching’ means ‘cat’ in Malay.
e.z: 「Kuching」這個詞在馬來語中意思是「貓」。

e.e: Many languages use a single word to mean both music and dance.
e.z: 許多語言用一個詞同時表示音樂和舞蹈。

e.e: The flashing light means (that) you must stop.
e.z: 閃爍的燈光表示你必須停下來。

e.e: Don't be upset—I'm sure she meant it as a compliment.
e.z: 別難過——我確定她是把它當作讚美。

e.e: The chair was clearly meant for a child.
e.z: 這張椅子顯然是為小孩準備的。

e.e: All our children have had the measles.
e.z: 我們所有的孩子都得過麻疹。

e.e: These statistics are not very meaningful.
e.z: 這些統計數據不太有意義。

syn.m: 引起回忆或唤起感情的...

e.e: Leave the cake to cool completely. Meanwhile, make the topping.
e.z: 讓蛋糕完全冷卻。與此同時，製作配料。

e.e: The storm is expected to move north today. Concerns are mounting meanwhile for a missing surfer.
e.z: 暴風雨預計今天會向北移動。與此同時，對一名失蹤衝浪者的擔憂正在增加。

e.e: The doctor will see you again next week. Meanwhile, you must rest as much as possible.
e.z: 醫生下週會再來看診。在此期間，你必須盡可能多休息。

e.e: I will put an information pack together and send it to you. Meanwhile, here are some links to useful websites.
e.z: 我會整理一份資訊包寄給你。與此同時，這裡有一些有用網站的連結。

e.e: Stress can be extremely damaging to your health. Exercise, meanwhile, can reduce its effects.
e.z: 壓力對健康極具破壞性。另一方面，運動可以減輕其影響。

d.m: 可测量的；重要的；可预见的

e.e: Econometrics deals with measurable and measured quantities in economics.
e.z: 计量经济学的对象是经济学中可测量和已测出的量。

e.e: At 27 months after therapy, one patient was free of measurable retinoblastoma.
e.z: 经过 27个月的治疗后，其中一个患者已经没有可测量的视网膜胚细胞瘤。

e.e: D. H. Laurence is a measurable figure in literature.
e.z: 劳伦斯是文学界的一个重要人物。

e.e: I'm changing my email address but for the meantime you can use the old one.
e.z: 我正在更換電子郵件地址，但在此期間你可以繼續使用舊的。

e.e: My first novel was rejected by six publishers. In the meantime I had written a play.
e.z: 我的第一部小說被六家出版社拒絕。在此期間，我寫了一部劇本。

e.e: The next programme starts in five minutes; in the meantime, here’s some music.
e.z: 下一個節目五分鐘後開始；在此期間，這裡有一些音樂。

d.m: 测量，测量法；尺寸，尺码；大小

e.e: Accurate measurement is very important in science.
e.z: 精確測量在科學中非常重要。

e.e: The research is based on the measurement of body fat in schoolchildren.
e.z: 這項研究基於對學童體脂肪的測量。

e.e: It is important to take precise measurements of the structure.
e.z: 對結構進行精確測量很重要。

e.e: The exact measurements of the room are 3 metres 20 by 2 metres 84.
e.z: 房間的準確尺寸是3公尺20公分乘以2公尺84公分。

e.e: A hand is a measurement used for measuring horses.
e.z: 「手」是用來測量馬匹的單位。

e.e: Blood pressure and heart rate should be measured before treatment.
e.z: 治療前應測量血壓和心率。

e.e: A nurse visited country schools to weigh and measure children.
e.z: 一名護士走訪鄉村學校為兒童稱重和測量身高。

e.e: A ship's speed is measured in knots.
e.z: 船速以節為單位測量。

e.e: He's gone to be measured for a new suit.
e.z: 他去量身訂做一套新西裝。

e.e: A dipstick is used to measure how much oil is left in an engine.
e.z: 量油尺用來測量引擎中還剩多少機油。

e.e: As an actress she longed to play one of the meatier roles, like Lady Macbeth.
e.z: 作為女演員，她渴望扮演像馬克白夫人那樣更有份量的角色。

d.m: 机械地；呆板地；无意识地

e.e: The patient was mechanically ventilated.
e.z: 病人接受了機械通氣。

e.e: The theory was flawed electrically, mechanically and energetically.
e.z: 這個理論在電氣、機械和能量方面都有缺陷。

e.e: She spoke mechanically, as if thinking of something else.
e.z: 她機械地說話，好像在思考別的事情。

e.e: He's always been mechanically minded.
e.z: 他一直很有機械頭腦。

e.e: He looks at the mechanics of a car before the bodywork.
e.z: 他在檢查車身之前先看汽車的機械結構。

e.e: The exact mechanics of how payment will be made will be decided later.
e.z: 付款的具體機制將在稍後決定。

e.e: The Greek initiated the science of mechanics.
e.z: 希腊人开创了力学这门科学。

e.e: Mechanics is taught by Dr. Hill.
e.z: 力学由希尔博士教授。

e.e: As she grew older her hobbies included science and automobile mechanics.
e.z: 随着年龄的增长，科学与自动车机械学也成了她的爱好。

e.e: The production process is now highly mechanized.
e.z: 生產過程現在已高度機械化。

e.e: He got a medal for bravery.
e.z: 他因勇敢而获得一枚奖章。

e.e: She was awarded a medal for bravery.
e.z: 她因勇敢而获得奖章。

e.e: He got a medal for his gallantry.
e.z: 他因勇敢而赢得一枚勋章。

e.e: The Secretary-General was asked to mediate in the dispute.
e.z: 秘書長被請求調解這場爭端。

e.e: An independent body was brought in to mediate between staff and management.
e.z: 一個獨立機構被引入來調解員工與管理層之間的問題。

e.e: Wilson tried to mediate between the European powers to end the war.
e.z: 威爾遜試圖在歐洲列強之間調解以結束戰爭。

e.e: The UN attempted to mediate a solution to the conflict.
e.z: 聯合國試圖調解衝突的解決方案。

e.e: Educational success is mediated by economic factors.
e.z: 教育成功受到經濟因素的影響。

e.e: The breakdown was due to a mechanical failure.
e.z: 故障是由於機械故障造成的。

e.e: My work has become mechanical—I could do it in my sleep.
e.z: 我的工作變得機械化——我閉著眼睛都能做。

e.e: Then, a median period of recurrence and survival was reckoned.
e.z: 计算术后中位数复发和中位数生存时间。

e.e: The students were asked to find the median of a set of numbers.
e.z: 同学们被要求从集合数中找出中位数。

e.e: An improved median filtering algorithm is presented in this paper.
